mapper.select: SELECT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t1.as_cj_cd AS asCjCd , t1.jy_suik_rt AS jySuikRt , t1.danga AS danga , cj.cj_nm AS cjNm , NVL(t1.jy_suik_rt * 100, 0) AS jySuikPer , t1.chgtime AS chgtime , TO_CHAR(t1.chgtime, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS chgtimeStr FROM SCM1SM t1 , SCM0CJ cj WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND cj.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND cj.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ORDER BY t1.as_cj_cd ASC

SELECT DISTINCT t1.corp_gr AS corpGr , TO_CHAR(t1.ymd, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ymd , t1.jm_cd AS jmCd , t1.jm_cd AS asCjCd , NVL(f_jm_nm(t1.corp_gr, t1.jm_cd), '') AS cjNm , NVL(sm.danga, 0) AS danga , 0 AS jySuikRt , 0 AS jySuikPer FROM SCM0CM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN SCM1SM sm ON sm.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND sm.ymd = f_open_ymd(t1.ymd, '-1') AND sm.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd WHERE t1.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t1.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SCM1SM sub WHERE sub.corp_gr = t1.corp_gr AND sub.ymd = t1.ymd AND sub.jm_cd = t1.jm_cd ) ORDER BY 3 ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO SCM1SM ( corp_gr, ymd, jm_cd, as_cj_cd, danga, jy_suik_rt, chgtime ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{jmCd}, #{asCjCd}, #{danga},
#{jySuikPer} / 100 #{jySuikRt} null , SYSDATE )
mapper.update:
MERGE INTO SCM1SM t USING DUAL ON (t.corp_gr = #{corpGr} AND t.ymd = TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD') AND t.jm_cd = #{jmCd}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.as_cj_cd = #{asCjCd} , t.danga = #{danga} , t.jy_suik_rt = #{jySuikPer} / 100 #{jySuikRt} t.jy_suik_rt
, t.chgtime = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( corp_gr, ymd, jm_cd, as_cj_cd, danga, jy_suik_rt, chgtime ) VALUES ( #{corpGr}, TO_DATE(REPLACE(#{ymd}, '-', ''), 'YYYYMMDD'), #{jmCd}, #{asCjCd}, #{danga},
#{jySuikPer} / 100 #{jySuikRt} null , SYSDATE )
